description: The server settings an admin can change at runtime: pen names, custody modes, device signing, invite-only sign-up, email verification, moving here and federation peers. Requires admin role.

main.description: Each setting's value in effect and where it comes from. Precedence: environment variable, then an admin's change, then the setup wizard's choice, then the profile or built-in default. A setting the environment sets is fixed: shown, never changeable here.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not an admin.

profile.description: OPENFEDERATION_PROFILE, which supplies defaults; absent or null when unset.

problem.description: Set when the saved changes conflict with the environment and are ignored until that is fixed.

refreshSeconds.description: How often every instance re-reads the settings; a change reaches other instances within this time.

envVar.description: The environment variable that sets it, and fixes it when set.

value.description: The value in effect: a boolean, an integer, a string, or a list of strings.

fixed.description: True when the environment sets it.

fallback.description: The value without an admin's change.

changedAt.description: When an admin last changed it, when the admin's value is in effect.
